title: Dugway 'grey beard': 'we had the triangles out again last night'

tellings.quote: would say, "Oh, we had the triangles out again last night."

plain: Between about 2019 and 2022, an old hand at Dugway Proving Ground, an Army testing range in Utah, would casually say things like "Oh, we had the triangles out again last night." A researcher known online as UAPGerb tells this as something he heard there himself. He takes it as a hint that triangle-shaped craft were flown or tested at the site as a matter of routine.
